No. 2447/53 - FRIDAY, AUGUST 01, 2025
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (amendment) Act No. 28 of 1964 that the Government has intended to acquire the below mentioned land for a public purpose.

Description of the land to be acquired : Thirty Seven (37) allotments of land in total extent of about 0.3006 Hectare, depicted in the Cadastral Map No. 512045 dated 31.12.2024 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village called Thelangapatha in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 176 of Ragam Paththuwa in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Wattala in Gampaha District of the Western Province and bounded as follows.

01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Thotawaththa; Present land use : Home Garden, two permanent buildings, part of a permanent building and a crop cultivation are available; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Could not be traced; Extent: 0.0093 Hectare.

P.D. T. C. Rajika, Divisional Secretary, Wattala. At Divisional Secretariat - Wattala, 15th July, 2025. EOG 08 - 0003
